critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the upper-deck hump geometry by increasing its longitudinal length along the fuselage axis to extend it 40% further toward the rear. Simultaneously, increase the vertical width of the hump cylinder by 25% and apply a fillet radius of 1.5 units at the nose-to-hump junction to eliminate the flat surface area and create a smooth blend with the cockpit curvature.

discrepancies.observed: The upper-deck hump ends abruptly near the front of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The hump extends significantly further back along the top of the fuselage.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase length along the longitudinal axis

discrepancies.observed: A sharp, distinct transition between the nose and the upper-deck cylinder.
discrepancies.reference: A smooth, continuous curve blending into the main deck.

discrepancies.observed: The hump appears as a narrow tube on top of the fuselage.
discrepancies.reference: The hump is wider, blending into the main body's curvature.
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: increase width along the vertical axis

discrepancies.observed: A flat surface area between the nose cone and the start of the hump.
discrepancies.reference: The hump begins almost immediately behind the cockpit windows.
